canonical_title: Night vision imaging system compatible emergency lighting

versions.title_at_revision: Night vision imaging system compatible emergency lighting
versions.text:
Standard: Night vision imaging system compatible emergency lighting conforms to MIL-STD 3009, Chromaticity Requirements table and NVIS Radiance Requirements Using English Units table. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Test.
(1) Ground test: Night vision imaging system spectral radiance is tested IAW MIL-STD-3009, Warning, Master Caution, Caution Signal, and Emergency Exit Lighting Radiance paragraph.
(2) Ground test: Night vision imaging system chromaticity is tested IAW MIL-STD-3009, Chromaticity Requirements table for NVIS green A/B or NVIS white.
